commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze migration impact: risk scores, affected tables, estimated duration

commands.name: audit
commands.description: View, export, and verify the signed audit trail

commands.name: drift
commands.description: Detect schema changes made outside of SqlDeployer

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Analyze SQL scripts for dangerous patterns and convention violations

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Repair the migration history — clear errors, rehash scripts, remove orphaned records

commands.name: reverse
commands.description: Reverse engineer database schema to SQL migration scripts

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Rollback migrations by executing Down/ scripts in reverse order

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Declarative schema management — read from ORM, apply, diff

commands.name: simulate
commands.description: Simulate migration on a shadow copy of the database

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Create a schema snapshot for drift detection or point-in-time reference

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current migration status of the database

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate migration integrity — checksums, missing files, token placeholders

commands.name: vault
commands.description: Manage encrypted connection strings per environment
